days.lab_task: Build a semantic registration form with associated labels, required fields, error messages and a confirmation region. Test it using keyboard-only navigation and submitted invalid and valid sample values.
days.deliverable: HTML page, accessibility checklist and form test evidence
days.assessment:
Every input has an associated visible label
Tab order reaches all interactive controls in the expected sequence
Invalid email is reported clearly and valid input reaches the confirmation region without claiming server-side validation
learning_objectives: Use semantic form controls and associated labels
Describe client-side validation limits
days.scenario: A registration page is unusable with a keyboard and submits incomplete profile data.
preparation_requirements: Prepare the stated lab fixture or training environment

Verify expected results: Every input has an associated visible label; Tab order reaches all interactive controls in the expected sequence; Invalid email is reported clearly and valid input reaches the confirmation region without claiming server-side validation
